_source.title: 移除跟随鼠标的提示
_source.remarks.text.0: 移除当前或指定的跟随鼠标的提示

title: Remove the follow-mouse tip
remarks.text.0: Remove the current or specified follow-mouse tip
params.tip: Tip content. If passed in, the tip is only removed when the current tip matches the specified content
